title: Industrial Sander
body:
"Not sure how this thing doesn't catch on fire, but it's basically the base sander except better!"

Description

The Industrial Sander can be purchased at Oak Depot for $20,000. It turns normal wood into sanded wood by removing its bark. It is the best sander in the game.

Appearance

The Industrial sander looks exactly like the Metal Sander except its red in color.

Trivia

  • Highest tier of sander ingame.
  • Has a Golden Skin in the Rewards Menu.
